note: Split of the remaining G4 defuns (179 at 6992047b0 dump) by source FILE.  The build script is one file and stays with core; 'tail' lives in the same file (see tail_note).
recipe:
1. F_w keeps F's params with OUT renamed _pad in place (rename an existing _pad to _pad1); it returns the value WORD; F becomes (defun F (.. out ..) (nl_abi_word_to_rc (F_w .. 0 ..) out)).
2. Failure: (nl_abi_fail RC 0) -> 0 with a signal guaranteed stashed; never return a bare 0. 2 = not found / unhandled (lookups, nl_apply_special_w, reader EOF only); lookup adapters use nl_abi_lookup_to_rc (2 -> rc 1); a miss never goes through nl_abi_fail.
3. Producers: nelisp_eval_call_w (form env 0), nl_apply_function_w (f args env 0), nl_apply_special_w (2 = not special), nelisp_env_lookup_value_w / nl_env_lookup_val_w / nelisp_env_lookup_function_w (2 = unbound), nl_sf_progn_w (body env 0 0) for any implicit progn.
4. Pattern (lisp/nelisp-cc-sf-{progn,if,while,setq,let,let-star,function}.el): rewrite the CPS chain with _w helpers that thread no OUT and return the word; delete helpers that only threaded OUT (a deleted F counts as converted); keep status helpers (while: 0 continue/1 error/2 done).
5. Unit constraints in lisp/ units: extern-call only as the first-evaluated argument, at most one nested call per argument list, even arity; cross-unit _w calls may be direct.
6. A tail `0` in old code means 'value already in OUT' -- find what was last written (nl_cons_write_nil -> 3, a prior eval -> its word); it is never mechanical.
7. Values a WORD must hand to an unconverted view consumer: a pointer word is its own box; an immediate goes through (nl_val_load w (alloc-bytes 32 8)) (see nl_sf_setq_view). Views from nl_cons_car_ptr returned as a value go through nl_val_store_word (R4).
8. Constructors whose OUT is the object being built (lambda closure, conses): F_w allocs the box, calls the builder, returns (nl_abi_status_fail rc box) -- the box is the object, no copy.
9. R2: a word that must survive a later safepoint (prog1/prog2 value, unwind-protect body value across cleanup, caught values) needs the same home the old OUT box had; a native local covers the main thread only. Note every such case in your notes.
10. Build-time patches match defuns BY NAME in scripts/nelisp-standalone-build.el (--patch-binding-kinds, --patch-n3-specials incl. nl_sf_lambda/nl_ali_*/nl_apply_lambda_inner, --patch-n4-apply/-cons, --patch-eval-inner, --patch-sf-cc, --patch-autoload-lookups). When a body moves to F_w, grep the build script for 'F and send the patch edit to core (owner of the build script) instead of editing it.
